summary: Validated the walletSudo->walletBatch module split. Git blocker checks pass: HEAD=332368ef, check-file-size.mjs exits 0 ('[file-size] OK'), check-secrets.mjs exits 0, walletSudo.ts=269 lines & walletBatch.ts=288 lines (both <=500), git status --porcelain is empty. Backend regression via http://localhost:8001/api all green: GET /wallet/sudo/status without auth -> 401; POST /api/user/login -> 200 (token at data.accessToken); GET /wallet/sudo/status with Bearer -> 200 with data.active=false; POST /wallet/batch with Bearer but no sudo -> 403 code=SUDO_REQUIRED (confirms requireWalletSudo middleware + batchWalletMutate re-export wired). Did NOT call request-otp and did NOT create sudo session (LIVE PROD DB / SAFE MODE). Frontend smoke on preview URL: 2-step login OK, /wallet loads, wallet-manage-btn opens wallet-manager-modal, unlock gate wallet-manager-unlock renders with 'Verify it’s you' title and wallet-manager-send-code-btn visible; closed via wallet-manager-cancel-btn (also x-btn works). Zero console errors from WalletManagerModal (only a benign Next.js 'Abort fetching component' during route switch on the first run, unrelated to modal).
critical_code_review_comments: walletSudo.ts re-export of batchWalletMutate from ./walletBatch keeps import surface stable in walletController.ts/walletRouter.ts — good split, no behavioral change.

check-file-size.mjs stderr WARNs on legacy grandfathered files growing (adminController, paymentLinkController, chainVerification, etc.) — not blocking today but worth planning extractions before the baseline is bumped.

WalletManagerModal fetches sudo/status before rendering unlock gate; brief loading spinner is fine, but a data-testid on the loading state would make automated tests more deterministic (currently must poll for wallet-manager-unlock).
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only tests only; no sudo session created, no batch mutation executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: walletSudo split is verified end-to-end. If retesting, use preview URL https://dynopay-settlement.preview.emergentagent.com and the 2-step login (email -> Continue exact -> password -> signin-submit-btn). Login token is at response.data.accessToken. To assert the sudo gate for /wallet/batch, send Bearer only (no sudo cookie/session) and expect 403 SUDO_REQUIRED. Never call request-otp more than once (30s throttle) and never complete a sudo verify — SAFE MODE against LIVE PROD DB.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — the original blocker (walletSudo.ts=545 lines tripping check-file-size.mjs 500-line cap in the husky pre-commit) is already fixed via split into walletSudo.ts (269) + walletBatch.ts (288). Both are now under the limit, check-file-size.mjs exits 0, and commit 332368ef is on HEAD.
